# AppScout
> Research of 100 apps for agent-toolkit feasibility (auth, access, API, MCP, verdict) with evidence URLs.

- [pass2.json](pass2.json): verified records, one per app (schema in scout.py FIELDS)
- [pass1.json](pass1.json): first-pass records
- [score.json](score.json): hand-checked accuracy, first pass vs verified, with misses
- [patterns.json](patterns.json): clusters and counts
- Trigger: GET /research?app=NAME[&verify=1] on `python scout.py serve`
